thread:
elaine: Cutting RC for user-service sha=2b7d1fa. Window 2026-04-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need QA + sheriff for canary.

releng-bot: RC created id=6077. Artifacts pinned: user-service:2b7d1fa. Promote to canary: `/deploy promote rc/6077 --env canary --percent 3 --kv-warm`

mike: staging quick smoke passed, saw a small auth retry at 21:05.

elaine: tagging @sheriff for rollback plan. Rollback target pre-approved: user-service:9f1c2b0. Rollback cmd: `kubectl set image deploy/user-service user-service=9f1c2b0 -n prod`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started rc/6077 -> canary (3%). KV warm 45s.

mike: canary smoke OK. error rate steady 0.15% -> 0.2%.

elaine: starting prod ramp: `/deploy promote rc/6077 --env prod --stages 10,50,100 --wait-metrics`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Prod ramp started -> stage 10%. Notifying oncall.

sheriff: alert: spike in downstream auth 502s at 10% stage. threshold hit. Recommend pause.

elaine: pausing ramp. `/deploy abort-stage rc/6077 --reason "downstream auth 502 spike"`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Ramp paused at 10%. Reason: metric(auth_502) breached threshold.

mike: quick triage: traces show auth-service timeouts when header size hits ~1.6k. Could be malformed long cookies from leftover test clients.

elaine: options? quick ingress tweak or rollback. Which is faster to mitigate?

sheriff: prefer non-deploy mitigation first. If we can patch ingress buffer quickly, try that. If not, rollback.

mike: I can apply ingress buffer bump now and restart proxy (2m). Doing it. `kubectl apply -f ingress-buffer.yaml && kubectl rollout restart ds/proxy -n infra`

releng-bot: ingress config applied, restart in progress.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Proxy restart completed.

sheriff: auth 502s dropping back to baseline.

elaine: resuming ramp to 50% with a 15m observation window. `/deploy promote rc/6077 --env prod --resume --stages 50,100`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Resuming promotion: now at 50%. Monitoring metrics.

mike: 20m at 50% looks stable. No new auth 502s.

elaine: promoting to 100%. `/deploy promote rc/6077 --env prod --stages 100`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion to 100% complete. Prod running user-service:2b7d1fa.

sheriff: monitoring completed, signals green.

elaine: release notes added: "User-service: auth flow resilience improvements; applied temporary ingress buffer bump during ramp; follow-up: add long-header synthetic tests." link: https://redwood.internal/release/6077

mike: creating a follow-up ticket for frontend client cleanup to remove long test cookies.

elaine: thanks all, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
